a: A lasso drawn while zoomed in reads as a click and clears the selection, because its "tiny" test and vertex spacing are in world units
Cut deletes the `operands` but copies whatever the clipboard dep's own selection reader names, so with host-supplied operands it deletes nodes it never copied
Make Boolean Group does not re-express an envelope operand's children, so they jump when the operand changes frame
`useAlign` / `useDistribute` write `setPose` on a selected derived-pose node, so an envelope group in the selection does not move (the actions move its sources)
Reorder reports enabled with no `scene` dep, though its run does nothing without one
Copy and Cut report enabled without a `clipboard` dep, so Cmd+C / Cmd+X are claimed and do nothing
b: A lasso's "tiny, so a click" threshold is a fixed 4 world px², so a real lasso when zoomed in, or a long straight one, clears the selection
Cut copies the clipboard dep's selection but deletes the `operands`, so with a host-supplied operand list the deleted nodes never reach the clipboard
Pathfinder actions gate on `operands` but run on the booleans adapter's own selection
Rotate with `pivot: 'each'` takes a selected derived-pose group apart: each child turns about its own center, while Flip `'each'` treats the group as one item
